# DXIL / LLVM bitcode fixtures

These are raw LLVM bitcode streams (they begin with `BC\xc0\xde`), not
`DXBC` containers. They are embedded by `dxil_bitcode.rs` unit tests with
`include_bytes!` so the tests are hermetic.

## clang fixtures (`a64`, `a32`, `none`, `dx64`, `dx32`)

Produced with Apple clang 21.0.0 (`clang-2100.1.1.101`) on macOS, using the
exact commands below. The `.ll` sources are shown in full so a reviewer can
re-derive every byte.

```sh
clang -O0 -c -emit-llvm -target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc X.ll -o X.bc
```

`a64.ll` — `atomicrmw` on `i64` (expect `Present`):

```llvm
define void @f(ptr %p) {
  %r = atomicrmw add ptr %p, i64 1 monotonic
  ret void
}
```

`a32.ll` — identical except `i32 1` (expect `Absent`).

`none.ll` — no atomics (expect `Absent`):

```llvm
define i64 @f(i64 %a, i64 %b) {
  %r = mul i64 %a, %b
  ret i64 %r
}
```

`dx64.ll` — a call to a `dx.op.atomicBinOp.i64`-named declaration with an
`i64` result (expect `Present`). This is a clang-produced stand-in for the
DXIL intrinsic naming scheme, not a DXC product:

```llvm
declare i64 @"dx.op.atomicBinOp.i64"(i32, i32, i64, i64, i64)

define void @f(ptr %p) {
  %r = call i64 @"dx.op.atomicBinOp.i64"(i32 1, i32 0, i64 1, i64 1, i64 0)
  ret void
}
```

`dx32.ll` — the same shape with `i32` / `dx.op.atomicBinOp.i32`
(expect `Absent`).

## DXC fixtures (`dxc_atomic64_buffer`, `dxc_wave64_lanes`)

These are the LLVM bitcode streams extracted from the committed DXC
SM 6.6 shader headers in
`tests/conformance/test_d3dmetal_gpu_limits/shaders/` (#453). Those headers
are generated by Microsoft's official DXC v1.9.2609; see that directory's
`compile.sh` for the exact compiler invocation and provenance.

Extraction procedure (from the `DXBC` container stored in the header):

1. Walk the `DXBC` chunk table and find the `DXIL` chunk.
2. In the `DxilProgramHeader`, read `BitcodeOffset` and `BitcodeSize`.
   `BitcodeOffset` is relative to the `DxilBitcodeHeader` (the `DXIL`
   magic at program byte 8).
3. The `BitcodeSize` bytes at `8 + BitcodeOffset` are the raw LLVM
   bitcode stream stored here.

- `dxc_atomic64_buffer.bc` comes from `atomic64_buffer.h`
  (`g_atomic64_buffer_cs`), a typed-UAV 64-bit atomic compute shader.
  Expect `Present`.
- `dxc_wave64_lanes.bc` comes from `wave64_lanes.h`
  (`g_wave64_lanes_cs`), a `[WaveSize(64)]` shader with no 64-bit
  atomics. Expect `Absent`.
